purpose: Resolve the retained AI-built-app review watch without inventing a narrower price-band story. Test China payer truth, existing routing, acceptance/settlement infrastructure, and recurring demand-pump evidence.

decisive_result.reason: The underlying production-readiness problem is real, but current Chinese routes already cover low-cost automated review and human project finishing/review with matching, acceptance and settlement. No Chinese payer evidence was found for a distinct standardized independent-senior-review layer that creates non-bypassable orchestration value. A perceived price gap between automated scanning and formal security audit is not an observed missing edge.
not_claimed: This packet does not claim human review has no value.
It does not claim every AI-built application is adequately reviewed by current tools.
It does not claim a fixed-scope human review product could never work.
It closes the current Rooter route because an independent orchestration residual and payer premium were not observed after incumbent search.

real_problem: Chinese developer communities contain current discussions about whether vibe-coded software is safe enough to launch and examples of AI-built software reaching real users.
Current Chinese guidance increasingly treats AI review as a pre-release risk screen and reserves human judgment for higher-risk conclusions.
demand_truth.boundary: Concern, production use and advice to seek human review do not establish payment for a separate standardized reviewer-routing layer.

facts: Current official service sells AI security scanning at RMB 188 per website.
The service targets pre-launch security checks, outsourced-code audit and legacy-system baselining.
It states technical experts manually validate scan results.
AI repair is sold separately at RMB 880 per website.
incumbent_routes.why_it_matters: The low-price end already bundles code intake, automated evidence, expert validation and a deliverable report without requiring a separate reviewer marketplace.

incumbent_routes.route: Direct human project finishing for vibe-coded software
facts: Current page explicitly targets Cursor/Codex/Trae-style vibe-coded prototypes that need finishing before launch.
It defines the work as code review, security hardening and deployment/launch rather than full rebuild.
Published budget reference is roughly RMB 300-2000 per developer-day.
It explicitly promotes direct connection to the programmer, delivery-based acceptance and no platform commission.
incumbent_routes.why_it_matters: This is extremely close to the hypothesized minimum unit. The buyer can already obtain senior human judgment plus remediation/launch help without a new intermediary.

incumbent_routes.route: Existing developer matching + trust + acceptance + settlement control plane
facts: The platform matches projects to developers using experience, skill, time and other dimensions.
It supports testing as a project stage and short/remote developer engagement.
Project work uses milestones, code/document submission, customer acceptance and platform settlement.
If work quality or personnel is inadequate, the platform can coordinate replacement and remediation.
Payment is released after acceptance; disputes and delivery standards are part of the existing workflow.
incumbent_routes.why_it_matters: The exact Rooter control-plane components—matching, trust, work decomposition, acceptance, replacement and settlement—already exist in a mature domestic route.

observed_structure: Very low-cost automated security review exists.
Formal security/code audit can cost thousands to tens of thousands of RMB or more.
Flexible senior engineering supply can be bought by the day or project.
price_sandwich_rejected_as_opportunity_e.tempting_story: A few-hundred-to-low-thousands fixed human production-readiness review might sit between automated scan and formal audit.
price_sandwich_rejected_as_opportunity_e.reason: A price interval is not connection-pressure evidence. Current buyers can already buy a remote developer/reviewer directly at roughly the same economic unit. No evidence shows they are paying an additional orchestration premium for a separate independent review layer.

demand_pump_recheck.existing_natural_handoff: When builders need human help, existing freelance/remote-development routes already accept project finishing, code review, security hardening and deployment tasks.

rooter_execution_map_recheck.acceptance: risk-ranked report / tests / remediation priorities / optional launch checks
rooter_execution_map_recheck.conclusion: Good task mechanics do not establish a Rooter business when existing marketplaces and direct providers already route the same buyer to human engineering judgment and acceptance.

kill_conditions_hit: Domestic automated review already handles cheap pre-launch screening.
Domestic remote/freelance routes explicitly handle vibe-coded project finishing, review, hardening and deployment.
Existing platforms already provide matching, project decomposition, trust, acceptance, replacement and settlement.
No Chinese payer was observed buying a distinct standardized independent-senior-review unit after considering those routes.
No recurring non-founder demand pump into a separate review layer was observed.
Simple reviewer routing has high bypass risk and weak defensibility.

human_probe.reason: The candidate did not reach HIGH Mobilization with an observed missing edge. Asking builders whether they would pay for a narrower review package would be hypothesis-selling, not a surgical recent-event confirmation.

next_existing_route.selection_boundary: This is not promoted to P0. It is selected only as the next existing public-research object because RCL-001 was later deprioritized by the Mobilization gate, RCL-002 public evidence was not advancing, and RCL-006 lacks named buyer cost.
next_existing_route.next_truth: Find one named industrial task with measurable incumbent process/material cost that maps to a measured cluster-powder property, then define a bounded coupon/sample test and acceptance metric before any human contact.
kill_conditions: Existing mature powders/processes solve the task at lower total cost.
Industrial qualification cycle is too long/high-permission for cheap reality testing.
Measured lab advantages do not survive relevant industrial conditions.
Guoji already has adequate downstream application channels and the gap is ordinary sales expansion.
